metaDescription: Bombay vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Bombay boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Bombay social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Bombay exposure.
Weight range 8-15 lb (3.5-7 kg) and grooming needs (Short coat.) belong in the same Bombay household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Bombay is also monitored for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (hcm) risk talks, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Bombay appointments.
After the Bombay puppy/kitten series, keep adult FVRCP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Bombay boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the kitten and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Bombay row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra FVRCP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Bombay item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Bombay kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Bombay due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Bombay core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Bombay misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Bombay health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Bombay adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
